faq.q: Why is a Penticton property on a South Surrey / Langley REALTOR®'s listings page?
faq.a: The card itself shows why it is possible: it is Jared's listing carried under a different board's MLS® numbering (10395824) and listed by ROYAL LEPAGE NORTHSTAR (W.R.). The page's stated scope is "South Surrey, White Rock, Langley & the Fraser Valley," so the Penticton fourplex sits outside the page's own framing — whether that is deliberate (an investment listing marketed to his Fraser Valley buyers) is a question for Jared, recorded in Section 8.

faq.q: If I enquire on one of these listings without my own agent, who represents me?
faq.a: No one, until a client relationship is formed. BCFSA requires a BC licensee to work for either the buyer or the seller in a transaction, to disclose at the outset whether they can represent you and what duties are owed to clients and non-clients, and to tell unrepresented consumers the risks of dealing with a professional representing another party; dual agency is prohibited in BC except in the rarest of circumstances.
